tasks.title: Welcome call with new joiner prior to onboarding
tasks.description: Reach out to the new joiner before their Day 1 and introduce yourself as their buddy.

tasks.title: Day 1 call to ensure laptop delivery, ID card application etc.
tasks.description: Check in on Day 1 post induction to confirm laptop, ID card and other essentials are sorted.

tasks.title: Introduction with PM, the wider team and HRBP
tasks.description: Facilitate introductions between the new joiner and their Performance Manager, team members, and HR Business Partner.

tasks.title: Sharing coordinates for important SPOCs
tasks.description: Share contact details for key SPOCs — Admin, IT, Transport etc.

tasks.title: Complete overview of and assistance in filling all timesheets
tasks.description: Walk the new joiner through timesheet submission process and help them fill their first timesheet.

tasks.title: Share relevant charge codes
tasks.description: Provide the project and task charge codes the new joiner needs for timesheets.

tasks.title: Extend team meeting invites
tasks.description: Add the new joiner to huddle, standup, and other scheduled/recurring team meetings.

tasks.title: Understand any specific nuance for interns/CWK workers
tasks.description: If the new joiner is an intern or CWK, understand and communicate any specific policies or processes.

tasks.title: Familiarize with team structure and roles
tasks.description: Help the new joiner understand the team hierarchy, who does what, and their role within the team.

tasks.title: Connect with team leadership
tasks.description: Introduce the new joiner to team leads and senior leadership.

tasks.title: Ensure completion of all mandatory trainings within timeline
tasks.description: Follow up to confirm all GLMS mandatory trainings are completed on time.

tasks.title: Raise access request for necessary DLs
tasks.description: Help raise access requests for any Distribution Lists the new joiner needs.

tasks.title: Overview of Intranet and iSeek policy hub
tasks.description: Walk the new joiner through the KPMG intranet and the iSeek policy hub, highlighting important sections.

tasks.title: Familiarize with main portals
tasks.description: Walk through GLMS, TalentKonnect, Rekonnect, Happay, Kites, Support Central, My Seat and all timesheet portals.

tasks.title: NJ should be made aware of AskHR portal
tasks.description: Ensure the new joiner knows about the AskHR portal for all necessary and immediate query resolution.

tasks.title: Follow up and seek feedback on first two-week activities
tasks.description: Check in on how the first two weeks went and gather feedback on the onboarding experience so far.

tasks.title: Connect with Tower Lead
tasks.description: Facilitate a meeting between the new joiner and the Tower Lead.

tasks.title: Familiarize with the Open PD process along with PM
tasks.description: Help the new joiner understand the Open Performance Development process together with their Performance Manager.

tasks.title: Check on the progress on process trainings
tasks.description: Review training progress and ensure all required process trainings are on track.

tasks.title: Assess any challenge being faced
tasks.description: Have an open conversation about any challenges or blockers the new joiner is facing.

tasks.title: Take feedback on overall onboarding process and share with lead and HR
tasks.description: Collect comprehensive feedback and share it with the team lead and HR for process improvement.

tasks.title: Continue to be the new joiner's ally
tasks.description: Remain available as a go-to person for any questions, concerns, or support the new joiner needs going forward.
